---
title: "Nest info"
toc: false
---

```{r setup}

library(glue)
library(tidyverse)

# Nest data ---------------------------------------------------------------

nests_start <-
  here::here("data/field_data.rds") %>% 
  read_rds() %>% 
  pluck("nests")

nest_list <-
  nests_start %>% 
  unnest(interval_data) %>% 
  summarize(
    last_check = last(date), 
    last_status = last(nest_status),
    .by = 
      c(
        nest_id:patch_id, 
        height,
        substrate, 
        location_description,
        discovery_date
      )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.character),
      ~ replace_na(.x, "Unknown")
    )
  ) %>% 
  split(.$nest_id)
```

```{r mapping, eval = FALSE}
map <-
  leaflet() %>%
  
  # Base tile layers:
  
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$Esri.WorldImagery,
    group = "Satellite",
    options = tileOptions(maxZoom = 21)
  ) %>%
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$OpenStreetMap,
    group = "Street Map"
  ) %>%
  
  # Patches drawn first so point layers render on top:
  
  addPolygons(
    data = patches,
    fillColor = "#ffffff",
    fillOpacity = 0.2,
    color = "#0000ff",
    weight = 1.5,
    opacity = 0.5,
    popup = ~ name,
    label = ~ name,
    group = "Patches"
  ) %>%
  
  addPolylines(
    data = paths,
    weight = 3,
    opacity = 0.7,
    dashArray = "2, 5",
    color = "#ffff00"
  ) %>% 
  
  # Nests
  
  addMarkers(
    data = nests,
    icon = ~ icons[icon_id],
    popup = ~ name,
    label = ~ name,
    group = "Nests"
  ) 
```

```{r output}
#| output: asis

nest_list %>% 
  walk(
    ~ glue_data(
    .x,
    "
<button class='accordion'><strong>Nest ID: {nest_id}</strong> (Species : {species})
</button>

<div class='panel'>

* **Patch**: {patch_id}
* **Plant species**: {substrate}
* **Height**: {height}
* **Location description**: {location_description}
* **Discovered on**: {discovery_date}
* **Last checked on**: {last_check}
* **Current status**: {last_status}

</div>

"
) %>% 
  cat()
  )

```

<script>
var acc = document.getElementsByClassName("accordion");
var i;

for (i = 0; i < acc.length; i++) {
  acc[i].addEventListener("click", function() {
  this.classList.toggle("active");
  var panel = this.nextElementSibling;
  if (panel.style.display === "block") {
    panel.style.display = "none";
  } else {
    panel.style.display = "block";
  }
  });
}

</script>
